title: Dashboard & discuss-list UI consistency (ref segments + scroll containment)
summary: Make dashboard Latest-Completed / New-Added cards use the same clickable+copy Fxxx/Pxxx/Txxx segmented ref as WorkTree, and fix Pi discuss/list commands' scroll containment so long lists stay in their viewport.
description:
F005 improvements sub-phase for two concrete UI consistency bugs discovered during the P069 resume-awareness work:

(1) Dashboard "Latest completed tasks" (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/latest-completed-tasks.tsx) and "New Added Tasks" (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/new-added-tasks.tsx) render only `EntityBadge type=task` (Txxx) + `ParentBadge` (Pxxx(Fxxx)) — they do NOT show the full clickable Fxxx/Pxxx/Txxx segmented reference with per-segment copy buttons that the WorkTree cards (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx) and the entity detail pages use. Goal: give both dashboard cards the SAME segmented ref header as the WorkTree — each segment (Fxxx / Pxxx(Fxxx) / Txxx) clickable (navigates to the entity) and each carrying a copy button for the number and the shortId. Reuse the existing reusable ref component (CompositeRef / segment + CopyableBadge in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/badges.tsx: CopyableBadge, EntityPathBadge, ShortIdBadge, formatEntityPath). If no single reusable segmented-ref component exists that does clickable-segments + copy for number+shortId, create one and use it consistently across WorkTree, entity detail pages, and these two dashboard cards so the header is identical everywhere.

(2) In Pi (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts), `/planner feature discuss`, `/planner phase discuss`, `/planner task discuss` (and any sibling command that populates a long entity list) render a list of features/phases/tasks that overflows the available height. It is scrollable, but when the user scrolls to the bottom the cursor/selection escapes the list viewport instead of keeping the items scrolled within the container. Must inspect ALL commands that populate a list view (feature discuss, phase discuss, task discuss, feature list, phase list, task list, handoff list, and any other list-rendering path) and fix the scroll containment / focus trapping so the list stays within its scroll area and items scroll up when at the bottom. Likely requires a shared scrollable-list component in the pi-adapter UI surface (ctx.ui) rather than per-command ad-hoc rendering.

Out of scope: changing the Web UI header (already addressed by P070/F005 and P071/F005); changing the planner core data model; GSD.

This phase deliberately lives OUTSIDE the P069 resume-awareness sequence — P069 (T296/T297/T298) and the P060 CI task (T258) take precedence and are worked first, per project instruction.

tasks.title: Reuse segmented clickable+copy ref header on Latest Completed / New Added dashboard cards
tasks.description:
Issue 1 (P072/F005): The dashboard cards `LatestCompletedTasks` (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/latest-completed-tasks.tsx) and `NewAddedTasks` (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/new-added-tasks.tsx) currently render only `EntityBadge type="task"` (Txxx) + `ParentBadge` (Pxxx(Fxxx)). The WorkTree cards (packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree.tsx) and the entity detail pages render the full segmented reference Fxxx / Pxxx(Fxxx) / Txxx where each segment is clickable (navigates to the entity) and each carries a copy button for the number AND the shortId, via the reusable helpers in packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/badges.tsx (CopyableBadge at line 241, EntityPathBadge, ShortIdBadge, formatEntityPath).

Work:
1. Inventory the existing reusable ref primitives in badges.tsx (CopyableBadge, EntityPathBadge, ShortIdBadge, formatEntityPath) and how WorkTree/detail pages compose them into the Fxxx/Pxxx/Txxx segmented header.
2. If a single composable segmented-ref component (e.g. `CompositeRef` / `RefSegments`) that renders clickable segments + per-segment copy for number+shortId does NOT already exist in a shared place, create one under packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/ui/ (reusing CopyableBadge + the existing navigation/Link pattern) so it is reusable.
3. Replace the `EntityBadge`/`ParentBadge` header in latest-completed-tasks.tsx and new-added-tasks.tsx with the same segmented ref header used by WorkTree (clickable segments + copy button for number and shortId), keeping the existing StatusBadge, title Link, feature/phase subtitle, and Completed/Added timestamp.
4. Verify the header segments are identical to WorkTree and detail page (clickable + copy number + shortId), and that the cards keep filtering semantics (latest 3 completed, new within 24h, transient New Added).

Code references: latest-completed-tasks.tsx:1-90 (EntityBadge/ParentBadge/StatusBadge usage at 40-43, 55-58); new-added-tasks.tsx:1-95 (EntityBadge/ParentBadge/StatusBadge + New pill at 41-48, 60-63); badges.tsx:241 CopyableBadge, 237+ copy helper with http-LAN fallback; work-tree.tsx (reference segmented header).

Tests: update any web-ui test asserting the old badge-only header on these cards (e.g. packages/plan-web-ui/test/entity-references-and-updates.test.tsx) to assert the segmented clickable+copy Fxxx/Pxxx/Txxx header is present; run `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/web-ui check` + the web-ui vitest suite; verify via the dev server (`pnpm dev`) in a real browser (browser-tools) that each segment is clickable and the copy button copies number+shortId.

tasks.title: Fix Pi discuss/list command scroll containment (cursor escapes list at bottom)
tasks.description:
Issue 2 (P072/F005): In Pi (packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts), `/planner feature discuss`, `/planner phase discuss`, `/planner task discuss` (and any sibling command that populates a long entity list) render a list of features/phases/tasks that overflows the available height. It is scrollable, but when the user scrolls to the bottom the cursor/selection escapes the list viewport instead of keeping the items scrolled within the container — i.e. the list is not properly contained in its own scrollable surface.

Work:
1. Locate every command handler that renders a long entity list: `feature discuss`, `phase discuss`, `task discuss`, `feature list`, `phase list`, `task list`, `handoff list`, and any other list-rendering path in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts (search discuss/list/scroll/overflow). Confirm which share a rendering path and which are ad-hoc.
2. Determine the Pi UI surface used (ctx.ui.* list/scroll primitives) and where the scroll container / focus handling lives — the bug is likely a missing `overflow` containment, a focus/selection trap that lets the cursor leave the list, or a container that grows with content instead of clipping to a max height.
3. Introduce or reuse a single shared scrollable-list component for the pi-adapter command UI so ALL list-populating commands keep their items inside a fixed-height scroll area (scroll up when at the bottom; cursor/focus stays within the list). Apply it to every command found in step 1 — do NOT fix only discuss while leaving list/handoff broken.
4. Verify the long-list behavior in the real Pi harness: scrolling to the bottom keeps items within the viewport and does not let the cursor escape the page.

Code references: packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts discuss handlers (PLANNER_COMMAND_COMPLETIONS list ~118-141 incl. "feature discuss"/"phase discuss"/"task discuss"/"handoff list"; command dispatch at ~1150-1164; handler bodies around 1239+ for project/feature/phase/task discuss). The list UI is rendered through the extension ctx.ui surface.

Tests: if the pi-adapter has unit/integration tests for the discuss/list rendering (packages/pi-adapter/test), extend or add coverage for long-list scroll containment; otherwise document the manual verification via the real Pi harness (`pi --no-extensions -e ...` or the user's launch) since this is a TUI scroll-focus behavior. Run `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build` + its test script green.

Identify the Pi UI scroll container / focus-trap bug causing cursor escape at list bottom
